name: Spandakārikā Checkpoint 1 — Blind Translation & Reference Comparison

disagreement_outcomes.SANSKRITREE_ERROR: A clear grammatical or factual error in Sanskritree output
disagreement_outcomes.REFERENCE_ERROR_OR_WEAKNESS: Reference translation contains an error or weak rendering
disagreement_outcomes.REFERENCE_INTERPRETIVE_EXPANSION: Reference adds interpretive expansion not in source
disagreement_outcomes.BOTH_DEFENSIBLE: Both renderings are valid readings of the source
disagreement_outcomes.TEXTUAL_VARIANT: Different underlying Sanskrit source text / edition
disagreement_outcomes.COMMENTARY_DEPENDENT: Disagreement depends on which commentary is followed

causal_origins.FRAME_ROLE: Role assignment within a semantic frame
causal_origins.SEMANTIC_PLAN: Overall semantic plan / ordering of propositions

severity.CRITICAL: Changes doctrinal meaning, reverses negation, omits a clause, or adds unsupported doctrinal claim. Every CRITICAL error blocks release.
severity.MAJOR: Grammatical error that misrepresents grammatical relations, wrong subject/object, wrong tense. Requires post-edit correction.
severity.MINOR: Stylistic preference, word order, synonym choice. Defensible alternative exists.

adjudication_procedure.blinding_method: Labels randomized to Translation X / Y / Z before evaluator sees them
adjudication_procedure.stage_a: Blind adequacy + error-span judgment (no identities revealed)
adjudication_procedure.stage_b: Philological adjudication with identities, source variants, commentary
adjudication_procedure.evaluator_bias_controls: Translator identities revealed only after stage A recorded

reference_handling.storage: Access-controlled evaluation-only store outside retrieval indexes, embeddings, prompts, lexical stores, and candidate DB
reference_handling.ingestion_timing: References ingested ONLY after blind Pass 1 is frozen and hashed
reference_handling.leakage_prevention: Adversarial leakage tests: imports, DB permissions, filesystem, network, retrieval, embeddings, prompts, logs, serialization
reference_handling.pretraining_disclosure: Inference-time isolation tested and passed. Pretraining exposure of closed/third-party models cannot be ruled out.

primary_metrics.critical_errors: Count of CRITICAL errors — 0 required for release
primary_metrics.major_grammatical_errors: Count of MAJOR errors — ≤2 required for release

secondary_metrics.semantic_node_realization: ≥98% required semantic nodes realized in output
secondary_metrics.post_edit_efficiency: ≥25% lower median post-edit time than B2 baseline

repair_selection_rule: Fix top 3 systematic error classes by frequency. Each repair must be linked to observed errors. Add regression tests for each fix. Measure holdout regression before accepting.

release_criteria.departures_documented: All departures from references documented with justification
